219031.description:
We all want to be spoiled, embraced, and comforted by a mom!

A mom who gently embraces us...that's the kind of presence we need to heal the fatigue of everyday life! A friend's mom, a childhood friend's mom, a female boss's mom, a mom teacher—this anthology comic features these motherly, saintly women who will thoroughly spoil you!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

219032.description:
In a murim where war has become a thing of the past, even peace comes at a price. In an age where the fate of entire martial sects is decided through duels, prestigious clans secretly trade in human weapons known as “Amhyung”—individuals trained to master and counter the martial arts of rival sects. Raised for a single purpose—to ensure victory—they are mercilessly discarded and erased from existence once their usefulness has ended. But those who were cast aside have not forgotten. Now, the forsaken rise to exact their revenge.

(Source: Naver, translated)

219033.description:

219035.description:
The spacecraft Oveja Negra, which collects and sells space junk, was operating in the red again today. And Captain Hank was up to his eyeballs in debt. Then, one of the crew members Yuki picks up a mysterious distress signal and they discover an old, abandoned mining plant. Keen to salvage resources, Hank and his crew step inside the plant, but soon realize that something abnormal is happening there…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

219043.description:
500+ pages of Masami Kuroda’s four-part series, "Mushitarou-den," a unique, bizarre, period epic all in one volume! With no mother and no father, what will become of Mushitarou—a supernatural boy struggling to survive while tossed about by the ruthlessness of the sengoku period Japan? No matter how much he’s tormented, he slashes his enemies’ throats and gouges out their eyes—the heartbreaking and endearing story of a lonely boy fighting to survive.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

219045.description:
The 19th volume of the Mandarake Kaiki Kashihon Kidan Series is from Yukio Tani’s “Kidan Series” published by Tokyo Manga Publishing. It features two unique fantasy stories—"Aribito no Mori" and "Boukon no Numa"—in which mysterious characters confront strange monsters in a fantastical world, now reprinted for the first time! A dazzling world of adventure that is somewhat reminiscent of Tatsunoko animation and Tsuburaya tokusatsu.

219081.description:
I was raised in a large family without any private space, but finally got permission to live alone upon entering high school. Except it came with a condition: "Don't have inappropriate relationships with the opposite sex." And yet, just after helping out my neighbor and classmate out of a jam—Arisa Amagi, a gal—she's been trying to seduce me in every possible way?! There's no way I can resist this! A romantic comedy with some spiciness and a lot of sweetness begins!

(Source: Overlap, translated)
